text:
sarah_ml: flagged by nightly eval: pset-gold v13 trim caused a drop in factuality on 'dates' subset, +8% failure vs baseline
jenna_research: ugh, did we remove examples with explicit year anchors?
mike_research: looks like it. I trimmed a few low-variance examples to shrink the set for faster runs.
sarah_ml: paste of the failing metric rows from nightly:
```
pset: pset-gold v12 -> v13
subset: dates
metric: factuality_f1
baseline(v12): 0.912
v13: 0.836
delta: -0.076
```
jenna_research: that's not tiny. Canary results?
eva_evalbot: canary job for v13 ran on 1799998800, 2000 queries, seed-stable, 95% CI shown in dashboard (link: https://redwood.eval/pset/pset-gold/v13)
mike_research: I can roll back the trim tomorrow morning, but we should decide whether to rebaseline or revert the change.
ali_prod: from product perspective, smaller pset was requested for nightly speed, but not at the cost of user-facing quality. We need a consistent answer.
pablo_infra: can run a diffed canary against v12 and v13 again with 10k queries if useful, ETA ~ 2h to schedule on dedicated infra.
sarah_ml: OK — short checklist: (1) mike: produce the pset diff (which examples removed and why), (2) jenna/mike: quick manual spot-check of 50 random failing cases, (3) pablo: schedule big-canary, (4) ali: advise on whether to block release if confirmed.
mike_research: uploading diff now:
```
- removed: examples/anchors/year_anchor_01.json
- removed: examples/anchors/year_anchor_02.json
- removed: examples/format/year_variants.json
+ added: examples/anchors/year_anchor_01_abbrev.json
note: removed 42 examples, added 4 shorter variants
```
jenna_research: I skimmed 20 failures: many look like the model now omits the explicit year and defaults to 'this year' phrasing -> downstream interpretation break. Seems like coverage loss, not just noise.
ali_prod: blocking release until manual check done? I'm leaning yes.
sarah_ml: +1 to blocking until we at least rebaseline or revert. We want the nightly to reflect production-quality prompts.
pablo_infra: big-canary scheduled, job id canary-1799998950, will post results once done.
canary-bot: canary-1799998950 finished: v13 vs v12, 10k queries, factuality_f1: v12=0.911, v13=0.842, p<0.001
mike_research: that's pretty decisive. I'm in favor of reverting the trim and opening a smaller targeted edit to avoid removing anchoring examples.
jenna_research: alternative: reintroduce a small curated subset of anchoring examples (10) and rebaseline pset as v14 with documented tradeoffs. That might preserve nightly speed and quality.
sarah_ml: decision call: revert to v12 for now (rollback PR), then mike+jenna propose v14 by EOD with explicit rationale and regen metrics. ali_prod: sounds good, please cc stakeholders in the rollback PR.
mike_research: creating rollback PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/psets/pull/1245
jenna_research: I'll start drafting v14 plan and annotate which examples are critical.
sarah_ml: thanks all. postmortem follow-up: tag: pset-trim-incident, assign to mike_research for root-cause writeup.
eva_evalbot: noted. nightly alert suppressed for this pset until v14 is in canary. :white_check_mark:
